model.name: Transcription Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 30B-A4B INT8 Experts
model.description: Transcribes an audio or video recording into text that says who spoke and when, with word timings and subtitles, or translates it to or from English; offline, in 40 languages, for recordings of up to an hour. This variant gives the reference accuracy for high-end PCs (about 33 GB of files, 64 GB of RAM recommended). Speaker numbers tell the voices of one recording apart; they do not identify people.

prompt: # Optional context terms, e.g. Dr. Amara Okafor, Kubernetes, etcd (lines starting with # are ignored)
